paite: Manasseh alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga alal a; anu min Hephzibah ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Manasseh / (2 Kro 33.1-20)
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte, thilkihhuaitak ahihte uh bang, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Apa Hezekiah in ahihsiatsa mun sangte adingsak nawn a; Israel kumpipa Ahab hih bang in Baal maitamte adingsak a, Asherahte abawl a, van a om tengteng bia in a-nna uh asem hi.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Jerusalem ah ka min ka omsak ding," achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nihte ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Atapa mei ah apaisuaksak a, aisan leh bum ahih a, dawi zawlte leh kha napeuh adong hi. TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou thupi mahmah amah hehsak ding in ahih hi.
english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: TOUPA'N David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem khua, Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding," achihna mun ah Asherah lim khuaktawm atungkhia hi.
english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

paite: "Thu ka piak tengteng leh ka sikha Mosi in dan apiak tengteng zuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a pan Israelte khete leng ka kal ka suankhesak nawn sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

paite: Himahleh amau azui kei ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte hih sang tham a thupizaw thil hihkhial ding in Manasseh in mite alampialsak hi.
english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N asikha zawlneite zang in thu agen hi.
english: Yahweh spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

paite: "Judah kumpipa Manasseh in hiai thilkihhuaitakte ahih a, Amorte sang tham in ahihkhial thupi hi. Judahte'n leng amilimte a thil ahihkhelhsak ziak in," achi hi.
english: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

paite: TOUPA, Israel Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih khengzou khop in thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding hi.
english: therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

paite: Jerusalem tung ah Samaria tehna khau leh Ahab inkuan' ulum khai ka khung dia; mi'n akuangnul akilumletsak bang in Jerusalem ka nul ding hi.
english: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

paite: Ka goutan khosuaksunte ka taisan dia, amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding.
english: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh tuni pha a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahih ua, hon hehsak ziak un, amelma tengteng mat ding leh gallak ding ahi ding uh," chi in achi hi.
english: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih loutak hih a Judahte thil ahihkhelhsak, khelhna a sim lou in Manasseh in poi khoih lou sisan nakpitak in asuah lai a, Jerusalem dung leh vai adimsak hi.
english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Manasseh tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihkhelhte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Manasseh api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Uzza huansung a om ama inn huan mah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ammon alalta hi.
english: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ammon alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum nih alal a; anu min Mesullemeth, Jotbah a Haruz tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ammon
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

paite: Apa Manasseh hih bangmah TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

paite: Apa lampi tot tengteng atawn sam a, apa septe milimte nna sem in amaute abia hi.
english: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, api-le-pute Pathian apaisan a, TOUPA lampi atawn kei hi.
english: and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.

paite: Ammon sikhate'n amah aguksawm ua, kumpipa amah inn ah athatta uhi.
english: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

paite: Himahleh huai gam a mite'n kumpipa Ammon guksawm mi tengteng athat vek uhi. Huchi in huai gam mite'n atapa Josiah asik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

paite: Huchi in Ammon thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Uzza huan a amah han ah avui ua; asik in atapa Josiah alalta hi.
english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
